name: Yume no Shoujo ~Dream Girl~
source:
Main character is a sophomore in high school. He often sees a girl in his dreams. One day he meets her and remembers that she's his childhood friend and first love partner.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名高中二年级学生，经常在梦中见到一名少女。一天，他终于与她相遇，并想起她正是自己的青梅竹马，也是自己的初恋。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
